decisions.quote: Conclusions The association of rs4867568 and rs143383 with KOA was successfully replicated in the Chinese Han population. Moreover, rs4867568 was found significantly associated with the severity of KOA. More studies are warranted to explore the functional role of rs4867568 in the development of KOA.

decisions.reason: Parent independently inspected the complete available publisher preview abstract and reference list. Current authors report re-testing GDF5rs143383andFTO rs1558902in addition to shipped LSP1P3variant, but give no experiment-specific citation in the available abstract. References contain multiple GDF5reports, including Miyamoto2007andValdes2011andTurkish2017primary findings plus reviews/meta-analyses, and multiple FTO reports. Prominence of a discovery paper, shared exact variant, or bibliography inclusion cannot uniquely establish which earlier paper/finding this current study retests or whether several are targeted. The missing current Introduction/Methods/Discussion citation context remains an actual primary access/identity limit after the acquisition history and two preserved review attempts. Keep unresolved, not an exclusion and not a forced missing identity; original expert failed-envelope labels are not automatically accepted.
